headline: No More Filing It Yourself: UAE Clinics Will Now Handle Your Sick Leave Attestation
summary:
Patients in the UAE will no longer have to file their own sick leave attestation requests at facilities licensed by the Ministry of Health and Prevention (MoHAP). Under the new streamlined process, the clinic or hospital that issued the sick leave will now submit and handle the attestation request directly on the patient's behalf.

The same automated arrangement also extends to patient companion leave, eliminating unnecessary paperwork and individual portal submissions for residents and employees across the Emirates.

Officials noted that this upgrade is part of the UAE government's Zero Bureaucracy programme, where success is measured by visible gains in customer experience, faster digital turnarounds, and operational efficiency across healthcare and public services.

headline: Why the 5:30 PM GST Dubai-to-Wall Street Overlap is the Most Profitable Window for UAE Traders
summary:
For retail and institutional traders residing in Dubai and Abu Dhabi, the late afternoon window between 5:30 PM and 8:30 PM GST represents the single highest-liquidity trading window of the 24-hour cycle.

During these three hours, European desks in London are executing their closing auctions while the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) and NASDAQ ring their opening bells—creating tight spreads and decisive breakouts across US tech equities, gold (XAU/USD), and major currency pairs.

Using a synchronized session clock and pre-calculating stop-loss position sizes before the 5:30 PM GST bell rings helps traders avoid emotional execution during peak opening volatility.
